summary: A2 symmetric sqrt: tuning=0.3979, HELDOUT=0.4997 BEST. Beats BM25 (0.4734) by +5.6%. TREC-COVID +3.3%, Touché +27%, SCIDOCS +0.2%, Quora -0.3%. ZERO length params.
A1+B1 combo: tuning=0.3903, heldout=0.4478. Worse than A1 alone. B1 log-tf hurts long-doc datasets when combined with root length.
D1 likelihood-ratio: tuning=0.4041, heldout=0.4047. Most consistent (gap=0.1%) but lower absolute. Quora 0.7796 best of all forks.
C1 tempered-idf: tuning=0.3955, heldout=0.4441. Quora 0.7702 good, but overall worse than baseline
B1 log-tf: tuning=0.3995, heldout=0.4092. ArguAna 0.4171 great, Quora 0.7629 great, but FiQA 0.1913 and Touché 0.1838 bad
b=0.8: FiQA +4.6% but SciFact -0.4% and ArguAna -2.8%. Net same as b=0.9. Keep b=0.9.
Short-doc penalty 0.05: 0.4095->0.4085. Still worse than 0.15. The penalty helps more datasets than it hurts.
Remove short-doc penalty: 0.4095->0.4080. Penalty helps other datasets, just hurts FiQA. Need adaptive penalty.
DROP log-norm, use BM25 linear norm + short-doc penalty + adaptive saturation. 0.4029->0.4095 (+1.6%). BEATS BM25 (0.4064) by +0.76%. Log-norm was HURTING with stemmed tokens!
k1=2.0: plateau at 0.4029, same as k1=1.8. Keep 1.8.
k1=1.6: slower saturation for stemmed tokens. 0.4021->0.4027 (+0.15%). Stemming reduced token count so k1 needs to go up.
IDF-conditioned b with 0.1 scale: 0.4021->0.4005. Better than 0.3 but still worse than no conditioning. The concept hurts avg but might help specific datasets.
IDF-conditioned b with 0.3 scale: too aggressive. 0.4021->0.3982. Try gentler scaling.
Short-doc penalty 0.25: slightly worse. 0.4021->0.4012. 0.15 is still better.
b=0.75: worse even with stemming. 0.4021->0.3957. b=0.9 still optimal.
Re-baseline with stemmed tokenizer on 4 tuning datasets. BM25=0.4064, BM199=0.4021 (behind by 1.1%). Params need re-tuning for stemmed input.
Short-doc penalty 0.15 (Codex suggestion): 0.4009->0.4020 (+0.27%). Now beats BM25 (0.4004) by +0.4%. Fixed FiQA over-rewarding ultra-short snippets.
Quadratic short-doc penalty: 0.4006->0.4009. Now BEATING BM25 by +0.12%. Short docs get penalized for lacking content, not rewarded for brevity.
log_base=1.5: same as log_base=2.0 (0.4006). No improvement, keep simpler log2.
IDF boost delta=0.1: slightly worse than no boost. 0.4006->0.4004. IDF boost not the right direction.
k1=1.5: overshoots. 0.4006->0.4000. k1=1.4 confirmed as optimal.
k1=1.4: 0.4001->0.4006. BEATS BM25 BASELINE (0.4004) FOR THE FIRST TIME. BM199 > BM25 by +0.02%.
k1=1.3: fine-tune from 1.2. 0.3999->0.4001. NOW MATCHING BM25 BASELINE (0.4004). First time BM199 approaches BM25.
Robertson IDF (no +1): negative IDF for common terms destroys scoring. 0.3999->0.3687. Standard IDF is better.
beta_min=0.85: slightly worse than 0.8. 0.3999->0.3997. beta_min=0.8 is optimal.
beta_min=0.8: milder adaptive saturation. 0.3994->0.3999 (+0.1%). Now within 0.0005 of BM25 (0.4004). The saturation was too aggressive at 0.5.
b=0.85: worse than b=0.9. 0.3994->0.3986. b=0.9 confirmed.
BM25L-style delta=0.5 added to TF before formula. 0.3994->0.3963. BM25L approach hurts with log-norm.
beta_min=0.6 beta_max=0.9: universal sublinear saturation hurts. 0.3994->0.3983. Common terms need near-linear TF.
k1=1.0: too fast saturation. 0.3994->0.3981. k1=1.2 confirmed optimal.
Blend log+power TF saturation by IDF. 0.3994->0.3974. Log saturation at query time hurts. Power-only is better.
Fix log-norm anchor: len_norm=1.0 at dl=avgdl. Same metric but mathematically correct normalization.
beta_min=0.5: stronger adaptive saturation for rare terms. 0.3990->0.3994. Nearly matching BM25 (0.4004).
b=0.95: too strong length norm. 0.3990->0.3977. b=0.9 with log2 is optimal.
log_base=2.0: stronger length compression via log2. 0.3983->0.3990 (+0.2%). Approaching BM25 baseline (0.4004).
k1=1.5: slower saturation. 0.3983->0.3980 (-0.1%). k1=1.2 remains optimal.
lambda_cov=0.0: disable coverage bonus. 0.3968->0.3983 (+0.4%). Coverage bonus was hurting — remove it.
beta_min=1.0: disable adaptive saturation. 0.3968->0.3959 (-0.2%). Adaptive saturation contributes positively, keep it.
b=0.9: stronger length norm with log compression. 0.3944->0.3968 (+0.6%). Log-norm benefits from higher b than BM25 linear norm
delta=0.0: disable BM25+ floor. 0.3820->0.3944 (+3.2%). Log-norm + adaptive saturation improves over default delta=1.0
